title: Vector Synthesis and Wave Sequencing
description: Dynamic timbre control through vector mixing and wave sequencing techniques pioneered by Korg Wavestation

content.overview: Vector synthesis creates evolving sounds by dynamically mixing multiple sound sources, while wave sequencing cross-fades through series of PCM waveforms

vector_synthesis.definition: Dynamic timbre control by mixing 2-4 oscillators using vector joystick or automated mixing
techniques: Manual joystick control for real-time performance
Vector envelopes for automated mixing over time
MIDI controller mapping for external control
vector_synthesis.applications: Creates evolving pads, complex textures, and expressive instruments that change character over time

wave_sequencing.definition: Programs a list of PCM waveforms that play in succession with programmable crossfades

wavestate_2_0.enhancement: Wave Sequencing 2.0 splits timing, sample sequence, and melody into independent 'Lanes'
wavestate_2_0.advantages: Much more complex and evolving sequences possible

wave_sequencing.applications: Rhythmic patterns, evolving pads, complex textures, unique soundscapes

evolving_pads: Slow vector envelope movement between waveforms
Long crossfade times for smooth transitions
LFO modulation of wave sequence position
rhythmic_sequences: Short step durations for rhythmic patterns
Program different pitches per step for melodies
expressive_performance: Map vector joystick to MIDI controller
Combine with aftertouch for additional expression

notable_usage: Depeche Mode, Phil Collins, Gary Numan
